from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Captures key legal metadata from a judgment document required for filtering and identification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's identifier or title as provided in the collection (e.g., 《判决文书 1》)")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The formal type of the legal document (e.g., '判决书', '裁定书')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action or legal category named in the document (e.g., '行政补偿', '行政赔偿', '行政给付')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
